reassessment_reason: The September 22 catalog projection did not incorporate the official fixed-width documentation already used by the offline connector. That documentation establishes daily full snapshots, status codes, file identifiers, records-office address fields, run dates, and count trailers; access and downstream rights remain separate unresolved gates.

candidate.product: Corporation and LLC Data Transparency daily full files; existing offline five-file processor
candidate.price: Publicly linked bulk files; no assessment-time payment or enrollment

access.bulk: The official Data Transparency page links Corporation and LLC bulk families and layout documentation. The existing connector accepts five operator-supplied same-run files offline.
access.api: No public API contract was established.
access.automation: The source expressly prohibits automated website queries. No unattended retrieval authorization is established; no website automation or download is performed.

fields.summary: Official version 004 documentation dated 2024-04-04 defines eight-digit file numbers, Corporation Master/Name/Annual widths 160/197/126 and LLC Master/Name widths 136/128, exact joins, RUN DATE headers and END OF FILE RECORD COUNT trailers. Corporation officer regions and agent, manager/member, stock, finance and other person-linked tables are excluded from the existing projection.

active_status_semantics: Codes 00 Goodstanding and 01 Reinstated are documented registry assertions, not proof of current business operation. The existing connector selects corporation types 4 domestic BCA, 5 not-for-profit and 6 foreign BCA, and LLC status 00/01. The corporation NGS display rule contains ambiguous month wording and is not guessed.
statewide_completeness: The documented full files cover their Corporation and LLC families, not every Illinois business or entity class. A complete same-run five-file package still must pass count and join verification. No statewide Illinois release or operator package was found during this assessment; Chicago retained license evidence remains municipal only.
address_zip: LLC Master explicitly defines records-office street, city, jurisdiction and nine-character ZIP. This is administrative registration evidence, may be residential, and is not a verified physical site. The existing connector keeps ZIP5 and ZIP4 separate; corporation person and agent addresses are excluded.
automation_terms_fees: Publicly linked bulk files do not override the explicit automated-query prohibition. Existing offline processing does not authorize source retrieval, account actions, agreement acceptance, source publication, national admission or production enrollment.
redistribution: The source disclaims completeness, accuracy and fitness. No new retention, transformation, geocoding, derived-publication or redistribution permission was established. Existing source policy keeps all outputs local-review-only pending written source confirmation and reuse review.
temporal_refresh: Both official layout documents specify daily full snapshots containing all records rather than additions or changes only, with source RUN DATE headers and record-count trailers. Archive availability, publisher checksums, correction/replay guarantees and actual package freshness remain unverified; no new source bytes were obtained.
offline_implementation: il-business-registry and il-business-registry-app already implement offline five-file validation and operation-scoped receipts. Their presence is implementation evidence only; no operation was dispatched, release created or pointer changed by this assessment.

citations.evidence: Official Corporation/LLC bulk families, informational-use disclaimers and explicit automated-query prohibition.
Version 004 corporation layout, daily full snapshots, unique file numbers, fixed widths, status and type dictionaries, source run/count controls, officer regions and ambiguous NGS rule.
Version 004 LLC layout, daily full snapshots, file numbers, fixed widths, status codes and records-office address/ZIP fields.

strongest_next_action: Retain the existing offline connector and documented layout evidence. If separately authorized, resolve retrieval and downstream-use terms and supply one complete official same-run package for independent offline verification. This assessment authorizes no contact, acquisition, processing operation, publication, admission or pointer change.
